card.name: Small words after a verb or noun
card.fires_on: Short function words like that, all, other, of, necessarily and the partial number 'some' in ordinary prose. They sit right after a verb or noun and begin a clause or noun phrase.

modes.label: that or all after a verb
modes.description: The word 'that' or 'all' follows a verb of thinking, knowing or having and introduces what comes next.
modes.example: be honest I don’t think<< that>> any of the composers represented here sound

modes.label: Fixed phrase pieces
modes.description: A small word sits inside a set phrase such as 'short of', 'the other day' or 'thirty-some years'.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words in everyday news and web prose, such as 'that' or 'all' after verbs like think or know.
